cn.t: This manga-to-musical adaptation divides critics with its unabashed sentimentality and emotional intensity. While some embrace its heightened romanticism and spirited cast, others find it overwrought, clichéd, and absurdly mawkish.

vr.q: I enjoyed this musical adaptation more than I enjoyed Death Note... this is a story that lends itself more to theatrical adaptation
